current_prompt.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers: {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64}
SET N=15
PARTITION L into N disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that for each i in 1..N, a_i + b_i = c_i
IF a valid partition exists THEN OUTPUT one complete example of the partition

current_plan.body:
READ the list L of integers and the value N
GENERATE all candidate triples (a, b, c) from L such that a + b = c
SELECT a collection of N disjoint triples from the candidates covering all elements of L exactly once
IF a valid collection exists THEN
    OUTPUT one example of the collection
ENDIF
